name: Glimmora
description: Glimmora, the Ore Pokémon, and the evolved form of Glimmet. A Rock and Poison type.
pokedex_entries: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.
Glimmora's petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.
